patterns.note: The main content area on the homepage uses a two-column layout, featuring a primary article list on the left and a sticky 'Current Issue' magazine promotion sidebar on the right.
Article listings consistently use a horizontal layout with a left-aligned image thumbnail and a right-aligned text block containing the title, description, and author/date.
Prominent, large, bold serif headlines are used for main article titles, creating a strong editorial feel, contrasted with smaller, lighter sans-serif for body text and metadata.

A high-contrast color scheme of black text on a clean white background is dominant, accented by a distinct teal/blue for interactive elements like links and CTA buttons, and a dark grey for the footer.
The primary navigation bar at the top of the page remains sticky, fixed to the viewport as the user scrolls down, ensuring constant access to main site sections.
The 'Current Issue' sidebar on the homepage also employs a sticky behavior, remaining visible in the right column alongside the main content for a significant portion of the page scroll.
Full-width, high-impact promotional banners, such as 'Unlock The Best of Dwell', are strategically interspersed between article listings to break content flow and drive subscriptions.

technique_notes: The site employs a classic sticky header that stays fixed at the top of the viewport, ensuring navigation is always accessible regardless of scroll depth.
A right-hand sidebar containing a 'Current Issue' promotion is implemented with a sticky behavior, allowing it to remain in view alongside the main content as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections and articles are revealed progressively as the user scrolls, with no complex scroll-triggered animations like fade-ins or parallax effects beyond the sticky elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter sans-serif body text and even smaller uppercase sans-serif labels for metadata.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, with most elements featuring sharp corners and only very slight rounding on interactive elements or images.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, providing good readability for articles, with slightly more airy spacing in hero sections and a denser grid for article listings on interior pages.

standout: The site's design stands out for its sophisticated editorial layout, effectively blending a traditional magazine aesthetic with modern web patterns. The prominent use of a classic serif font for headlines against a clean sans-serif body, combined with a sticky 'Current Issue' sidebar, creates an authoritative and immersive reading experience that feels more like a digital publication than a typical blog.
